text:
Nina Patel: Quick batch from last week's onboarding + two renewal calls (~32 clips + 9 support threads). Need a clean feed for PMs: atomic asks, classification (product/infra/enablement), impact score, and renewal risk tag. Can someone own a first pass today?

Omar Ruiz: I can take it. Proposal: run ASR -> extract candidate asks with heuristics -> human validate high-uncertainty items. We'll output CSV and a short priority matrix.

Leah Brooks: Agree. For impact scoring let's use a matrix instead of a single heuristic so PMs can filter by different signals. Fields: severity(0-5), customer_value(0-5), renewal_risk(0-1), frequency_count. Then compute two views:
- roadmap_score = severity*2 + customer_value*3 + frequency_count
- escalation_score = renewal_risk*10 + severity*2 + frequency_count

Miles Carter: Nice. That lets us isolate churny asks. Also add column 'enablement_only' so we don't clutter product backlog.

feedback-bot: Uploaded: cs_voice_batch_1756000000.zip -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/batches/cs_voice_batch_1756000000.zip :file_folder:

Omar Ruiz: CSV header I'll use:
```
customer,source,ref_id,ask,category,severity,customer_value,frequency,renewal_risk,enablement_only,roadmap_score,escalation_score,evidence_snippet,pattern_id,notes
```

Leah Brooks: Quick sample rows from first pass:
```
CobaltHealth,call,ch_07,"Per-route cost breakdown in Console","billing",4,5,2,1,false,18,18,"'need per-route toggle' - renewal call","billing-breakout-001","audio good"
MapleRetail,support,mr-204,"Clarify token billing for batches","billing",3,3,1,0,true,12,3,"asked in enablement session","billing-clarity-002","enablement suggested"
TerraOps,call,to_11,"Private model pinning or isolated VPC","infra",5,4,1,1,false,19,25,"security lead explicit","infra-pinning-003","escalate to infra"
```

Nina Patel: Good examples. Process notes: Omar -> run NLU dedupe so repeated asks get pattern_id; Leah -> mark enablement_only where it's purely docs/training; Miles -> assemble top-10 by roadmap_score and top-5 by escalation_score.

Miles Carter: On automation: propose rules we can later wire into automations engine:
- If escalation_score >= 15 OR renewal_risk==1 -> auto-open 'customer-voice-escalation' ticket and cc CSM
- If roadmap_score >= 15 AND enablement_only==false -> create product-candidate card
- If enablement_only==true -> create docs task in 'cs-enablement' board

Omar Ruiz: I'll template the auto-ticket body with evidence snippet + transcript excerpt + pattern links. Also will add estimated_effort (S/M/L) heuristics based on category.

Leah Brooks: For dedupe, I recommend fuzzy-match on ask text + pattern clustering (min cluster size=2). Assign canonical pattern_id like 'pattern-billing-XXX'. PMs prefer seeing grouped signals.

Nina Patel: Ownership: Omar owns extraction + ticket automation prototype, Leah owns dedupe + CSV quality check, Miles compiles slide(s) for PM sync. I'll escalate any P0/P1 renewal signals during the sync.

feedback-bot: Generated CSV: cs_voice_extract_1756000000.csv -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/exports/cs_voice_extract_1756000000.csv :file_folder:

Omar Ruiz: Heads-up: 4 clips with ASR_confidence<0.65 flagged as 'needs-listen' in notes. Two items explicitly said "we will not renew" -> both have escalation_score 25+. I already marked them urgent.

Leah Brooks: I'll run a small manual pass on low-confidence clips and add short evidence snippets. Also found a cross-customer pattern: 'ambiguous token quota messaging' across 6 accounts -> pattern_id=billing-ambig-006, estimated_effort=S. Recommend docs + small UX copy change.

Miles Carter: After PM triage, we should classify items into swimlanes: product-backlog, enablement, infra, legal (if privacy/compliance). Cross-links for anything that sits in >1 lane.

Nina Patel: Timeline: Omar finish extraction by 3pm, Leah finish dedupe and audio checks by 5pm, Miles produce AM sync slide deck with top-10 roadmap + top-5 escalations. PM sync at 10am tomorrow.

Omar Ruiz: Will push final CSV and trigger automation preview. Assigning automation owner to @Omar for the prototype.

Leah Brooks: Noted. I'll also tag each row with 'confidence' (high/medium/low) in the CSV so PMs know which asks were auto-extracted vs manual-verified.

Nina Patel: Thanks team. If legal/privacy checks are needed for quoting transcripts externally, tag 'needs-legal-review' in notes.

feedback-bot: Reminder: CS->Product weekly triage in 90 minutes. Agenda: voice-signal priority matrix + renewals.

Miles Carter: I'll add a small heatmap slide showing counts by pattern_id vs escalation_score so PMs can spot hotspots quickly.

Nina Patel: Great. I'll escalate the two high-risk customers now to CS leadership and attach the feed. See you in the triage.
